acceptance: A recorded decision on the lock version and the floor, citing the version-matrix results
If changed, the lock and floor change in a PR that keeps the polars-2-compat job meaningful
description: BenchBox runs on Polars 1.35.2 through 2.0.0, with the lock at 1.44.2 and the pyproject floor at 1.35.2. A required polars-2-compat CI job covers 2.0. After the Polars version matrix results exist, decide whether to move uv.lock to 2.0 and whether to raise the floor. This is a decision, not an implementation; the matrix work deliberately changes neither.
